$comment: CI admission budget on the liskov CI node. cdk8s builds the Kueue ClusterQueue and the Woodpecker agent's workflow cap from this file, and scripts/checks/ci/check-ci-admission-budget.ts proves the generated pipeline fits it. Quotas sit below liskov's allocatable (29 CPU, ~91.5Gi) on purpose: they are a guard, not permission to consume the node to zero. Delivery's executor reserve (2 CPU, 8Gi) is a separate Kueue queue beside this budget, so computeQuota.memory gives up the same 8Gi: every queue plus buildkitd must stay under the allocatable memory.
